companyDescription: Cell therapy biotech · Deramiocel for Duchenne muscular dystrophy cardiomyopathy · Phase 3 HOPE-3 positive · FDA AdCom Jul 29 + PDUFA Aug 22, 2026 (2nd review cycle after a lifted CRL)
priceNote: Down 4.18% today per live-prices.json cache (1.4h old). Stock has been volatile heading into the Jul 29 FDA Advisory Committee meeting — a real, scheduled second look at a drug that already received one Complete Response Letter in Jul 2025.
summary: Capricor's deramiocel (cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy cardiomyopathy) is on its second FDA review cycle: the agency issued a Complete Response Letter in Jul 2025, Capricor filed a Class 2 resubmission with additional positive Phase 3 HOPE-3 data (54% slowing of upper-limb decline, 91% slowing of cardiac LVEF decline, both statistically significant), and the FDA lifted the CRL in Mar 2026 with a new PDUFA date of Aug 22, 2026. An Advisory Committee meeting on Jul 29 — a real, additional layer of scrutiny given the prior rejection — comes first. Recent named-firm targets cluster $58-63, though Roth's more conservative $38 (down from $43) shows real disagreement persists. This is a binary, second-chance FDA event — size accordingly.

catalysts.name: FDA Advisory Committee Meeting
catalysts.description: The FDA's Cellular, Tissue, and Gene Therapies Advisory Committee meets Jul 29, 2026 to review the Deramiocel BLA. This is a real second layer of scrutiny the FDA specifically scheduled ahead of a second-cycle decision — not a rubber-stamp formality. A negative panel vote would be a strong (though not automatically binding) signal ahead of the PDUFA date.

catalysts.name: FDA PDUFA Decision (2nd review cycle)
catalysts.description: New PDUFA target action date following the Mar 2026 CRL lift and Class 2 resubmission incorporating Phase 3 HOPE-3 data. Approval, a second CRL, or an extension are all real outcomes.

risks: This is a SECOND review cycle — the FDA already issued one Complete Response Letter (Jul 11, 2025) citing insufficient substantial evidence of effectiveness; the CRL was lifted after more data, but the underlying regulatory bar that caused the first rejection hasn't disappeared

The Jul 29 AdCom is a real, additional scrutiny layer the FDA chose to schedule for this second-cycle decision — a negative panel vote would be a serious (not automatically fatal, but serious) warning sign ahead of Aug 22

Analyst target dispersion is wide ($38-$63) — Roth's most recent target ($38, lowered from $43) implies far less upside than the other three named firms, reflecting genuine, current disagreement about approval odds
Small market cap (~$1.2B) with a demonstrated 500%+ single-day move on a prior data readout — extreme volatility cuts both directions
Modest cash position (~$98.6M cash vs $14.5M debt, ~$84M net cash) — a second rejection would likely force a dilutive raise

estimateDates.note: Panel vote — real signal ahead of PDUFA, not a formality given the prior CRL

catalystSpot.preRunup: CAPR's own history shows this stock can move enormously on DMD news well before a scheduled decision — its Jun 2026 HOPE-3 topline data readout sent the stock from $6.36 to a $30 close (+371%) in a single session, an outlier even for binary biotech names.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: can move sharply on any incremental DMD data or FDA-process update, not just the two dated events themselves
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: highly variable — CAPR's own Jun 2026 HOPE-3 readout was +371% in one session

postWin.note: Sarepta's Elevidys approval (first-ever DMD gene therapy, same indication) triggered a same-day +30% move in 2023 — the cleanest direct comp for a DMD approval reaction. CAPR's own history (the +371% HOPE-3 data pop) shows this specific stock is capable of far larger moves than a typical approval-day reaction, though that was a data readout, not an approval decision.

postLose.note: CAPR's own first CRL (Jul 11, 2025) sent shares down 30% intraday, trading 39% lower pre-market — the most directly relevant precedent available since it's the same drug, same indication, same company.
